description:
This panel contains genes associated with breast cancer. 

Further information on the testing criteria for breast cancer can be found at eviQ: 
https://www.eviq.org.au/cancer-genetics/adult/genetic-testing-using-cancer-gene-panels/3413-breast-cancer-panel-testing

Only ‘Green’ genes should be tested and analysed for clinical testing, as they have sufficient peer-reviewed published evidence of association with breast cancer and are clinically actionable for diagnostic and/or predictive genetic testing.

Ensure testing includes copy number variant (CNV) analysis, as CNVs contribute to a clinically significant proportion of pathogenic variants associated with familial risk of cancer.

This panel has been compared against the Genomics England PanelApp and aligned with any assessments by ClinGen.

This panel has been developed under the guidance of experts in cancer genetics (Dr Helen Mar Fan and Dr Nicola Poplawski).
